title: Collective simplex mesh-quality preflight
summary: Computes normalized triangle/tetrahedron mean-ratio quality and turns a declared threshold into MPI-global preflight evidence.

science.statement: Simplex mean ratio compares physical area or volume with squared edge lengths and equals one for an equilateral element and zero for a degenerate element.

equations.label: triangle mean ratio
equations.description: The metric is dimensionless and normalized to one.

equations.label: tetrahedron mean ratio
equations.description: Six edge lengths and absolute tetrahedron volume define the metric.

inputs.name: simplex mesh and threshold
inputs.type: DOLFINx triangle/tetrahedron domain and q_min in [0,1]
inputs.unit_role: dimensionless quality; coordinates share any consistent length unit
inputs.description: Only owned cells contribute to collective counts and statistics.

outputs.name: MeshQualityReport
outputs.type: global min/mean/max, poor/invalid counts, and acceptance
outputs.description: Strict mode rejects the mesh when the declared acceptance rule fails.

assumptions: The selected topology is a triangle or tetrahedron solver domain.
conventions: Cells below threshold are poor; zero or non-finite cells are invalid.
applicability: Generated or imported simplex meshes, including C3D10 geometric topology preflight.
limitations: Mean ratio does not replace curved high-order Jacobian sampling or analysis-specific distortion checks.
Quadrilateral/hexahedron quality requires a different Jacobian-based contract and is rejected for now.

validation_rules: Recover sqrt(3)/2 for a right isosceles triangle.
Reduce counts and statistics collectively over owned MPI cells.
Reject unsupported cell types instead of reusing the simplex metric.

references.title: Algebraic mesh quality metrics for unstructured initial meshes
